description: This source file is a shell script that contains tests for Git notes merging functionality. It sets up various scenarios with different note trees, fanout levels, and merge strategies, and verifies the correctness and behavior of merging notes in Git repositories.

methods.name: verify_notes
methods.description: Verifies that the notes associated with a specific reference and commit match expected values by comparing against reference files and git note output.

methods.name: verify_fanout
methods.description: Checks if the notes tree for a given reference has a fanout of 1, verifying the hierarchical structure of the notes.

methods.name: verify_no_fanout
methods.description: Checks if the notes tree for a given reference has a fanout of 0, indicating a flat structure.
